# Sourdough starter

Feed at a ratio of one part starter, five parts flour, five parts water by weight. In a warm kitchen it peaks in six hours; in a cold one it needs twelve.

## Troubleshooting

- Grey liquid on top: hungry, feed more often.
- No rise after a week: use wholemeal rye for two feeds.
- Smells of acetone: too warm and underfed.

Bake when a spoonful floats in water.
